# Section-order templates

Ten published section orders. They agree on the spine — theme, goal, components, setup, overview, detail, end — and differ in how much reference apparatus they add. Pick the closest fit for the game's weight, then justify any departure.

## Stonemaier Games (Jamey Stegmaier)

1. Overview & Goal
2. Components
3. Setup
4. Gameplay Overview
5. Detailed Gameplay
6. Other Info
7. End of Game
8. (Last page) Icon guide / game flow / index

## Curby Style Guide (Michael Lee)

1. Thematic Introduction
2. Goal of the Game
3. Component List (illustrated)
4. Setup (with diagram)
5. Gameplay Overview
6. Round Structure
7. Turn Structure
8. Turn/Phase/Action Details
9. End-game Trigger
10. Scoring and Winning
11. Card/Action Notes & FAQ
12. Worldbuilding
13. Glossary
14. Credits
15. Index
16. Quick Reference (back cover)

## Resonym

1. Story
2. Goal
3. Game End
4. Components
5. Setup
6. Gameplay
7. Ending the Game

## Rules Writing 101 (Herc du Preez)

1. Title
2. Subtitle/Catchphrase
3. Game Information
4. Flavourful Overview
5. Table of Contents
6. List of Components
7. Victory Condition
8. Component Breakdown
9. Glossary of Terms
10. Setup
11. Game End
12. Turn Summary
13. Detailed Turn Description
14. Additional Rules (exceptions)
15. Examples of Play
16. Asides / flavour sidebars

## Meeple Mountain (Top Six)

1. Thematic Intro/Background
2. Thematic Objective
3. Component List
4. Set-up
5. How to read components
6. First Player selection
7. Typical Turn
8. Special Actions/Turns
9. Examples of Gameplay
10. Endgame/Scoring/Win Conditions
11. Appendix
12. Glossary
13. FAQ
14. Rulebook version

## Jeremy Lennert (BGG outline)

1. Introduction
2. Components
3. Setup
4. Game Concepts
5. Sequence of Play
6. Additional Rules
7. Common Mistakes
8. Hints & Tips
9. Glossary/Index
10. Summary/Player Aid

## Wargame convention (marc lecours)

1. Intro
2. Components
3. Key concepts (stacking / ZOC / supply)
4. Activation
5. Movement
6. Combat (losses, retreats last)
7. Political rules
8. Special rules
9. Victory conditions
10. Optional/advanced rules

## Shellhead (There Will Be Games)

1. Introduction (theme, players, time)
2. List of components
3. Victory condition
4. Set up
5. Phases of turn (rules grouped by phase)
6. Optional rules
7. Detailed example of play (2 turns)
8. Glossary
9. Back cover: turn summary, charts, icon key

## Teaching order (comprehension thread)

1. 1-2 sentences of theme
2. Win condition + end trigger
3. Big-picture flow
4. Details: phases, card anatomy, iconography, costs, combat

## Boardtastic (verbal teaching frame)

1. Theme
2. Overview
3. Structure
4. Actions
5. Rules
6. Exceptions
7. Victory
8. Summary
9. Strategy tips
